summary.oneLiner: A key India-based producer of Ethylene Amines, manufactured at its Vadodara plant, supplying building-block chemicals across Pharma, Agro-chemicals, Resins, Water treatment and other specialty applications.
summary.business: Diamines & Chemicals Limited manufactures Ethylene Amines at its plant in PCC Area, Vadodara, serving industry segments including Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients & Pharma-Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals, Agro-chemicals, Resins, Water treatment chemicals, Petroleum production chemicals and Additives. The company reports two primary segments: Specialty Chemicals (Ethylene Amines manufacturing) and trading in Fruits and Vegetables. It is supported by an in-house R&D centre and quality assurance department.

risks.risk: Single core-business concentration in Ethylene Amines
risks.note: Since the company's core business is Ethylene amines, any negative development or upheaval in the marketplace may affect the company's performance.
Fluctuating prices of certain key raw materials have the potential to impact performance in the short term.
Competitors that are forward or backward integrated with the advantage of economies of scale can swamp the market with excess, lower-priced or even duty-free product.
Threat of product substitution is imminent, especially with Chinese product incursions.

Decline in sales during FY26 is primarily attributable to adverse geopolitical developments that impacted international demand and customer ordering patterns, factors largely external and beyond the Company's control.

risks.risk: Global demand-supply imbalance in Ethylene Amines
risks.note: The Ethylene amines business is going through a demand-supply imbalance at a global level, expected to continue into FY27.

risks.note: The Company has experienced difficulties and uncertainty with respect to raw material costs, market demand, collections and liquidity.

risks.risk: Manufacturing-site environment, safety and health risk
risks.note: Under the Risk Management Policy, parameters at manufacturing sites are analysed to minimise risk associated with protection of environment, safety of operations and health of people at work, monitored against statutory regulations, including legal requirements on emissions, wastewater and waste disposal.

business_model.body: Diamines & Chemicals Limited manufactures Ethylene Amines at its plant in PCC Area, Vadodara, serving industry segments including Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients & Pharma-Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals, Agro-chemicals, Resins, Water treatment chemicals, Petroleum production chemicals and Additives. The company reports two primary segments: Specialty Chemicals (Ethylene Amines manufacturing) and trading in Fruits and Vegetables. It is supported by an in-house R&D centre and quality assurance department.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- The Ethylene amines business is going through a demand-supply imbalance at a global level, expected to continue in FY27
- Decline in sales during FY26 primarily attributable to adverse geopolitical developments that impacted international demand and customer ordering patterns, factors described as largely external and beyond the Company's control
- Company experienced difficulties and uncertainty with respect to raw material costs, market demand, collections and liquidity
- Prices of raw materials and products continue to be influenced by external factors into FY27

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Sustain and maintain market share in the industry segment where the company enjoys a market leadership position, via stronger customer relationships and beneficial raw-material supplier contracts
- Realign sales strategy and explore alternate markets to mitigate the impact of adverse geopolitical developments on international demand
- Plan to introduce new products
- Make all possible efforts to improve margins despite raw-material and product price pressures from external factors
- Continue conservation-of-energy measures: reducing steam consumption via improved insulation, LED lighting and high-efficiency motors, cooling-water debottlenecking, improved steam condensate recovery, utilisation of by-product steams, and automation for power factor correction
- R&D focus on developing import-substitute products and innovative technology to reduce footprint, reduce capex and enable environment-friendly manufacturing processes

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: No specific named capex project with a commissioning or completion timeline is disclosed in this bundle. The Company operates a captive Wind Turbine Generator (WTG) facility of total 0.75 MW capacity at Shikharpur, Kutch, Gujarat, used for captive consumption to reduce carbon footprint. The Company has planned a Hazard and Operability Analysis (HAZOP) for new installations and current operations to improve process safety, and continues energy-conservation measures including a planned increase in throughput alongside yield improvements.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Key manufacturer of Ethylene Amines in India, described as one of the premier suppliers, operating in a growth market
- Robust systems built over the years that help maintain and sustain operations despite challenges
- Geographical position and vicinity to customers offering advantages in customer servicing
- Ethylene Amines are building blocks for many industries, giving potential to grow via derivatives based on homologues of Ethylene Amines

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Single core-business concentration in Ethylene Amines — Since the company's core business is Ethylene amines, any negative development or upheaval in the marketplace may affect the company's performance.
- Raw material price volatility — Fluctuating prices of certain key raw materials have the potential to impact performance in the short term.
- Competition from forward/backward-integrated, scale-advantaged players — Competitors that are forward or backward integrated with the advantage of economies of scale can swamp the market with excess, lower-priced or even duty-free product.
- Product substitution / import incursion threat — Threat of product substitution is imminent, especially with Chinese product incursions.
- Geopolitical disruption to international demand — Decline in sales during FY26 is primarily attributable to adverse geopolitical developments that impacted international demand and customer ordering patterns, factors largely external and beyond the Company's control.
- Global demand-supply imbalance in Ethylene Amines — The Ethylene amines business is going through a demand-supply imbalance at a global level, expected to continue into FY27.
- Raw material cost, market demand, collections and liquidity uncertainty — The Company has experienced difficulties and uncertainty with respect to raw material costs, market demand, collections and liquidity.
- Manufacturing-site environment, safety and health risk — Under the Risk Management Policy, parameters at manufacturing sites are analysed to minimise risk associated with protection of environment, safety of operations and health of people at work, monitored against statutory regulations, including legal requirements on emissions, wastewater and waste disposal.
